name: jp.kosen-ac.kagawa.tk-hlsl
description: Generates typed C# ComputeShader bindings (kernel setters, Dispatch, cbuffer setters, StructuredBuffer element structs) at compile time from your .compute files. Mark a partial class with [ComputeShaderBinding("path/to/Shader.compute")] and the binding surface is generated for you — see the package README for the AdditionalFiles wiring this requires.
